nodes.name: __init__.py
nodes.summary: Package marker for pixelle_video.utils with a module docstring. Exposes no symbols itself; the package hosts all shared utility helpers consumed across pipelines, services, and the API layer.

nodes.name: bookend.py
nodes.summary: Project-level intro/outro bookend packaging defaults and normalization. Normalizes project/export config into a canonical bookend dict (enabled, intro_seconds, outro_seconds, fade seconds) accepting camelCase (frontend) and snake_case (backend) keys, clamping fades to pad durations. Product defaults: intro 1.2s / outro 2.0s.

nodes.name: content_generators.py
nodes.summary: Pure/stateless LLM content generation utilities reused across pipelines: title generation (auto/direct/llm strategies), narration generation from topic/content with batch + top-up strategy for 50-100 scene counts, narration script splitting, semantic segmentation, highlight keyword extraction (LLM with heuristic fallback + color palette), image prompt and video prompt generation with batching/retry, and robust LLM JSON parsing/recovery (truncated arrays, unescaped quotes, markdown fences, trailing commas).

nodes.name: ffmpeg_scratch.py
nodes.summary: Shared ffmpeg/TTS temp directory helpers and garbage collection. Provides a stable OS-temp scratch dir (pixelle_video_ffmpeg) and cleanup_ffmpeg_scratch which deletes stale files older than max_age_hours plus empty subdirs; called on API startup.

nodes.name: llm_util.py
nodes.summary: LLM utility functions for model discovery and connection testing against OpenAI-compatible /v1/models endpoints using httpx (trust_env=False to avoid dead local proxies). fetch_available_models lists model IDs; test_llm_connection returns (success, message, model_count) with detailed error mapping for 401/403/404/timeout.

nodes.name: os_util.py
nodes.summary: OS utilities for file and path management (inspired by Pixelle-MCP's os_util.py). Resolves the project root via PIXELLE_VIDEO_ROOT env var, provides temp/data/output path builders, byte-file saving, task ID generation and per-task output directory layout (output/{task_id}/frames/...), and resource management for bgm/templates/workflows with custom-override priority (data/<type> before <type>).

nodes.name: project_config.py
nodes.summary: Project config dual-key normalization between camelCase (editor/UI-owned, preferred when both present) and snake_case (pipeline) for ~26 key pairs (enableSubtitles, bgmVolume, mediaWidth, ttsMode, workflowId, bookendEnabled, directorMode, density, styleSlotId, etc.). pick_config returns first non-None key; normalize_project_config dual-writes both casings, preserves legacy sceneCount as a soft custom director target, and aliases workflow/media_workflow.

nodes.name: prompt_helper.py
nodes.summary: Prompt helper utilities for composing and validating visual prompts: whitespace normalization for comparing user-facing prompt fields, legacy fallback detection (visual_prompt copied from narration), and final image prompt assembly with an optional style prefix applied only at the provider boundary.

nodes.name: storyboard_split.py
nodes.summary: Semantic storyboard packing that mirrors frontend/src/lib/storyboardSplit.ts. Splits narration drafts into duration-aware units (auto/paragraph/line/sentence modes) without inventing mid-word/mid-phrase hard cuts: sentence-unit splitting, long-sentence splitting at pauses/semantic joins, bounded rhythm fallback for unpunctuated CJK text, soft-expand on pause punctuation, semantic packing to a target scene count, and healing of mid-cut segments.

nodes.name: template_util.py
nodes.summary: Template utility functions for size parsing and template management. Parses WIDTHxHEIGHT sizes from template paths, lists available sizes/templates merged from default and custom (data/) locations via os_util resource API, resolves template paths with backward-compatible default.html->image_default.html migration, detects template type (static_/image_/video_ naming), and builds TemplateInfo/TemplateDisplayInfo models grouped by size and type for the UI.

nodes.name: tts_audio_postprocess.py
nodes.summary: Lightweight per-scene TTS clip post-processing to reduce 'different speaker' artifacts: single-pass loudnorm (target I=-16 LUFS), short fade in/out via ffmpeg-python compiled command run with subprocess timeout (bounded 30-180s), writing to the shared ffmpeg scratch dir. Also provides with_speaker_lock which appends a Chinese speaker-identity constraint to multi-scene style prompts.

nodes.name: tts_util.py
nodes.summary: Edge TTS utility (original edge-tts implementation, temporarily unused — TTS service currently uses ComfyUI workflows). edge_tts() synthesizes speech with retry (exponential backoff + jitter), concurrency limiting via per-event-loop semaphore, request delay, word-boundary subtitle alignment saving, and optional output file. Also provides get_audio_duration (ffmpeg probe with size-based estimate fallback) and list_voices with locale filter.

nodes.name: video_canvas.py
nodes.summary: Video canvas (成片规格) vs image-generation size mapping. Defines 8 canvas presets (1080x1920 default @30fps, 720x1280 fast, 1440x2560 advanced, 16:9 and 1:1 variants), normalizes canvas config (width/height/fps with clamping, even dimensions for yuv420, tier detection), and maps any canvas to the nearest image-API whitelist size by orientation, aspect ratio, and pixel count.

nodes.name: workflow_util.py
nodes.summary: Standardized ComfyUI workflow path resolution for all services using convention {source}/{service_name}.json (source: runninghub default or selfhost). resolve_workflow_path returns the relative path; get_default_source returns 'runninghub' (cloud-first for beginners).

nodes.name: _to_float
nodes.summary: Convert value to float, returning default on TypeError/ValueError/NaN.

nodes.name: _clamp
nodes.summary: Clamp value into [minimum, maximum].

nodes.name: normalize_bookend_config
nodes.summary: Normalize project/export config into canonical bookend dict; accepts camelCase/snake_case and nested config.bookend object, coerces enabled flag from string/bool, clamps durations and fades (fades capped at pad duration), zeroes everything when disabled.

nodes.name: ffmpeg_scratch_dir
nodes.summary: Return (creating if needed) the shared OS-temp scratch directory pixelle_video_ffmpeg for ffmpeg/TTS intermediate files.

nodes.name: cleanup_ffmpeg_scratch
nodes.summary: Delete files under the shared ffmpeg scratch dir older than max_age_hours and prune empty subdirs; returns number of paths removed. Called on API startup.

nodes.name: fetch_available_models
nodes.summary: Fetch sorted model ID list from an OpenAI-compatible GET /v1/models endpoint with Bearer auth (trust_env=False to bypass dead local proxies).

nodes.name: test_llm_connection
nodes.summary: Test LLM API connection by fetching the models list; optionally verify a model exists. Returns (success, message, model_count) mapping 401/403/404/connect/timeout to user-friendly messages.

nodes.name: get_pixelle_video_root_path
nodes.summary: Resolve project root from PIXELLE_VIDEO_ROOT env var (resolved absolute path if it exists), falling back to the current working directory.

nodes.name: ensure_pixelle_video_root_path
nodes.summary: Ensure the root path and its output/ directory exist, then return the root path.

nodes.name: get_root_path
nodes.summary: Join paths relative to the Pixelle-Video root (ensures root/output exist first).

nodes.name: get_temp_path
nodes.summary: Join paths under the temp/ directory, creating it if needed.

nodes.name: get_data_path
nodes.summary: Join paths under the data/ directory, creating it if needed.

nodes.name: get_output_path
nodes.summary: Join paths under the output/ directory, creating it if needed.

nodes.name: save_bytes_to_file
nodes.summary: Write binary data to file_path, creating parent directories; returns the absolute path.

nodes.name: ensure_dir
nodes.summary: Create directory if missing and return its absolute path.

nodes.name: create_task_id
nodes.summary: Create a unique task ID '{YYYYmmdd_HHMMSS}_{4-hex}' with collision probability < 0.0001% per second.

nodes.name: create_task_output_dir
nodes.summary: Create isolated per-task output directory output/{task_id}/ with a frames/ subdir; returns (task_dir, task_id).

nodes.name: get_task_path
nodes.summary: Join paths within a task's output directory.

nodes.name: get_task_frame_path
nodes.summary: Build a frame file path 'NN_{audio|image|video|composed|segment}.{ext}' under the task's frames/ dir (1-indexed filenames).

nodes.name: get_task_final_video_path
nodes.summary: Return the task's final video path (final.mp4).

nodes.name: get_resource_path
nodes.summary: Resolve a resource file path for bgm/templates/workflows with custom-override priority: data/{type}/... first, then root {type}/...; raises FileNotFoundError with searched locations when missing.

nodes.name: list_resource_files
nodes.summary: List resource filenames merged from default and custom (data/) locations, deduplicated with custom taking precedence; optional subdir (e.g. template size).

nodes.name: list_resource_dirs
nodes.summary: List subdirectories of a resource type merged from default and custom locations.

nodes.name: resource_exists
nodes.summary: Check whether a resource file exists in either the custom or default location.

nodes.name: pick_config
nodes.summary: Return the first present non-None value among the given keys (order = priority), else default.

nodes.name: normalize_project_config
nodes.summary: Dual-write 26 known camel/snake key pairs so both casings stay in sync (camel wins when both present); preserves legacy sceneCount as soft custom directorMode target, defaults directorMode/density, and aliases workflow <-> workflowId/media_workflow.

nodes.name: normalize_prompt_text
nodes.summary: Collapse whitespace and strip for comparing user-facing prompt fields.

nodes.name: is_visual_prompt_same_as_narration
nodes.summary: Detect the legacy fallback where visual_prompt was copied from narration (case-insensitive equality after normalization).

nodes.name: build_image_prompt
nodes.summary: Assemble the final image prompt, prepending an optional style prefix only at the provider boundary ('prefix, prompt').

nodes.name: with_speaker_lock
nodes.summary: Append the shared Chinese speaker-lock phrase to a style prompt when multi_scene (or force), deduplicating if already present.

nodes.name: _postprocess_timeout_seconds
nodes.summary: Bound ffmpeg timeout for loudnorm: max(30, min(180, duration*2.5+20)) so a hung process cannot freeze generation.

nodes.name: postprocess_tts_clip
nodes.summary: Normalize loudness (single-pass loudnorm) and apply fade in/out to a TTS clip in-place via ffmpeg-python compiled command + subprocess timeout; writes via shared ffmpeg scratch dir and returns the original path unchanged on any failure.

nodes.name: resolve_workflow_path
nodes.summary: Resolve a ComfyUI workflow path using the convention '{source}/{service_name}.json', defaulting source to runninghub.

nodes.name: get_default_source
nodes.summary: Return the default workflow source 'runninghub' (cloud-first).

nodes.name: _to_int
nodes.summary: Convert to positive int with default fallback on error/non-positive.

nodes.name: normalize_video_canvas
nodes.summary: Resolve video canvas (media size + fps) from project config, defaulting to 1080x1920@30; snaps to known presets or clamps custom sizes to even 480-3840 dimensions; returns width/height/fps/preset_id/tier/is_advanced.

nodes.name: map_image_gen_size
nodes.summary: Map a video canvas size to the closest image-API whitelist size: exact hit, then same orientation, closest aspect ratio, then pixel count with undersize penalty.

nodes.name: image_gen_size_from_config
nodes.summary: Convenience: normalize canvas from config then map to image-gen size.

nodes.name: resolve_video_fps
nodes.summary: Convenience: return normalized fps from config.

nodes.name: clean_narration_text
nodes.summary: Strip speakable ordering labels (numbered prefixes like '1.', '第1段', '旁白1') from narration text before it reaches TTS, up to 3 iterative passes.

nodes.name: _clean_narrations
nodes.summary: Map clean_narration_text over a narration list.

nodes.name: generate_title
nodes.summary: Generate a short video title from content: 'direct' truncates content, 'auto' short-circuits <=15 chars, otherwise LLM via build_title_generation_prompt with quote/punctuation cleanup and smart word-boundary truncation to max_length.

nodes.name: generate_narrations_from_topic
nodes.summary: Generate n_scenes narrations from a topic via batched LLM calls (batch_size=12) with automatic top-up when batches return fewer items (common at 50-100 scenes).

nodes.name: generate_narrations_from_content
nodes.summary: Generate n_scenes narrations from user content with the same batch + top-up strategy as topic mode.

nodes.name: _generate_narrations_batched
nodes.summary: Core batched narration generator: splits target into batches, appends batch continuity context (global numbering, previous tail, source preview), collects chunks, cleans, and runs a last-resort global top-up; raises if still short.

nodes.name: _append_batch_context
nodes.summary: Append batch-generation instructions to a prompt: exact count for storyboards global_start-global_end, continue-the-arc note, source preview (<=800 chars) and previous narration tail.

nodes.name: _generate_narration_chunk_with_topup
nodes.summary: Request one narration chunk and top-up with extra LLM rounds (up to 4, deduplicated) until full or rounds exhausted; defers to global top-up when partial, raises on empty.

nodes.name: _topup_narrations
nodes.summary: Ask the LLM (Chinese prompt, strict JSON) for exactly 'need' more narrations continuing previous tail; returns cleaned list or [] on failure.

nodes.name: _coerce_narration_list
nodes.summary: Normalize LLM JSON/list payloads into non-empty narration strings, handling dict keys narrations/data/result/items/scenes and dict items with narration/text/content/ttsText.

nodes.name: split_narration_script
nodes.summary: Split a user narration script into segments by mode: auto (semantic storyboard_split auto_split_draft), paragraph (double newline), line (single newline), sentence (sentence punctuation via storyboard_split). Cleans and logs length stats.

nodes.name: _normalize_segment_match
nodes.summary: Strip all whitespace for segment equality verification.

nodes.name: segment_narration_semantically
nodes.summary: Ask the LLM for extractive semantic segmentation of a narration (text + boundary_reason + visual_focus + text_anchors per segment) and strictly validate: source text must round-trip unchanged, count <= target, per-segment <= max_chars.

nodes.name: generate_highlight_keywords
nodes.summary: Extract highlight keywords (word + hex color) from narration via LLM with style/density/avoid tuning; falls back to heuristics when the response cannot be parsed; validates words appear in source, caps at max_keywords with density cap.

nodes.name: _heuristic_keywords
nodes.summary: Fallback keyword extraction: English tokens + sliding 2-4 char CJK windows, stop/avoid-word filtering, rarity-ranked with color palette assignment and char de-duplication.

nodes.name: _normalize_keyword_words
nodes.summary: Normalize avoid-words to a casefolded set (max 48 entries, len <= 20).

nodes.name: _keyword_limit
nodes.summary: Cap keyword count by density (low=4, standard=8, high=12) within 1-24.

nodes.name: generate_image_prompts
nodes.summary: Generate one strict English visual prompt per narration in batches with retries, real director system prompt, optional style_prefix, one-to-one visual_focuses/text_anchors alignment, and progress callback.

nodes.name: _parse_image_prompt_response
nodes.summary: Parse an object-shaped image-prompt JSON response, stripping code fences and requiring non-empty string image_prompts array.

nodes.name: _repair_unescaped_json_quotes
nodes.summary: Repair unescaped quotes inside model-generated JSON string values: a quote only terminates the string when followed by structural JSON punctuation; otherwise it is escaped.

nodes.name: _loads_model_json
nodes.summary: Load JSON strictly, then retry with unescaped-quote repair; raises the original error when repair changes nothing or still fails.

nodes.name: generate_video_prompts
nodes.summary: Generate video prompts from narrations with batching, retry per batch, count validation, and progress callback; returns base prompts without prefix.

nodes.name: _narration_max_tokens
nodes.summary: Scale the completion token budget with item count (512 + n*120, clamped 1024-8192).

nodes.name: _request_narration_json
nodes.summary: Request narration JSON with up to 3 attempts (original/compact/retry prompts, thinking disabled, budgeted max_tokens) and layered recovery: strict parse, truncated-array recovery, plain-line fallback; returns best partial or raises.

nodes.name: _recover_truncated_narration_json
nodes.summary: Recover complete string items from a truncated narrations JSON array (marker or bare-array aware, unescaping values, skipping accidental keys).

nodes.name: _extract_narrations_fallback
nodes.summary: Best-effort recovery of narrations from plain-line LLM output (skips JSON scaffolding); accepts partial lists for top-up.

nodes.name: _parse_json
nodes.summary: Robust JSON parsing: normalizes smart quotes/BOM, strips markdown fences, prefers largest {..}/{..} span, trailing-comma repair, and raw_decode prefix scanning.

nodes.name: clamp_scene_count
nodes.summary: Clamp an int to [1, 100] scene bounds with default on parse failure.

nodes.name: split_draft_by_rule
nodes.summary: Split draft text by mode: auto -> auto_split_draft, paragraph -> double newline, sentence -> sentence-unit split, else line mode.

nodes.name: _meaningful_length
nodes.summary: Character length ignoring whitespace.

nodes.name: _split_sentence_units
nodes.summary: Split at sentence punctuation without breaking decimals, dates, domains, or version tokens; newlines end units.

nodes.name: _split_long_sentence
nodes.summary: Split a long sentence at pauses, then semantic joins, then a bounded rhythm fallback; merges tiny tails and re-falls back when any group still exceeds the rhythm cap.

nodes.name: _split_by_rhythm
nodes.summary: Guarantee bounded units for unpunctuated text: prefer pause/semantic-break cut points near 36 chars, else fixed-width CJK fallback moved off ASCII words; keeps meaningful tails.

nodes.name: _minimum_tail_length
nodes.summary: Compute a tail size bound (>= AUTO_MIN, <= target window) without extra tuning params.

nodes.name: _move_off_ascii_word
nodes.summary: Adjust a cut position so it does not split an ASCII word, scanning backward then forward within bounds.

nodes.name: auto_split_draft
nodes.summary: Create safe, duration-aware narration units: sentence units -> long-sentence splitting, without rewriting source text.

nodes.name: rebalance_long_units
nodes.summary: Re-split any packed unit still longer than the rhythm cap via _split_long_sentence.

nodes.name: soft_expand_by_pause
nodes.summary: Split units on ，； pauses only when both sides are substantial (>= 4 chars), keeping the pause on the left segment for natural TTS/hold boundaries.

nodes.name: pack_semantic_units
nodes.summary: Pack units to a target scene count via proportional chunking; never invents mid-sentence character cuts when there are fewer units than the target.

nodes.name: heal_mid_cuts
nodes.summary: Merge adjacent segments that look like hard mid-word/mid-phrase cuts (e.g. '科学家发'+'现...'), respecting terminal/pause punctuation and ambiguous long-pair heuristics.

nodes.name: _should_merge_mid_cut
nodes.summary: Heuristic deciding whether a left/right segment pair is a hard mid-cut that should merge (CJK/alnum continuity, punctuation absence, length rules).

nodes.name: build_storyboard_narrations
nodes.summary: End-to-end storyboard narration builder: rule split -> optional soft-expand -> pack to target_count -> rebalance -> optional heal; mirrors frontend storyboardSplit.ts.

nodes.name: parse_template_size
nodes.summary: Parse (width, height) from a template path's size directory (WIDTHxHEIGHT), validating bounds and format; raises ValueError with guidance.

nodes.name: list_available_sizes
nodes.summary: List available template sizes merged from templates/ and data/templates/ via os_util, filtered to valid WIDTHxHEIGHT dir names, sorted.

nodes.name: list_templates_for_size
nodes.summary: List .html template filenames for a size, merged from default and custom locations.

nodes.name: get_template_full_path
nodes.summary: Resolve a template's full path (custom first), raising FileNotFoundError listing available templates on miss.

nodes.name: format_template_display_info
nodes.summary: Build TemplateDisplayInfo (name, size, orientation, is_standard for the 3 standard sizes) for the UI layer.

nodes.name: get_all_templates_with_info
nodes.summary: Collect TemplateInfo for every template across all sizes (path + display info).

nodes.name: get_templates_grouped_by_size
nodes.summary: Group all templates by size, ordered by orientation priority portrait > landscape > square.

nodes.name: resolve_template_path
nodes.summary: Resolve flexible template input (None default, bare name, size/name, legacy templates/ or data/templates/ paths) to a full path; migrates default.html -> image_default.html with fallback.

nodes.name: get_template_type
nodes.summary: Detect template type from filename convention static_*/image_*/video_*, defaulting to image with a warning.

nodes.name: filter_templates_by_type
nodes.summary: Filter TemplateInfo list by type (static/image/video).

nodes.name: get_templates_grouped_by_size_and_type
nodes.summary: Group templates by size with optional type filter, orientation-ordered.

nodes.name: TemplateDisplayInfo
nodes.summary: Pydantic model carrying template display info for the UI layer: name, size, width, height, orientation (portrait/landscape/square), is_standard.

nodes.name: TemplateInfo
nodes.summary: Pydantic model bundling a resolved template_path with its TemplateDisplayInfo.

nodes.name: _get_request_semaphore
nodes.summary: Get or create the per-event-loop asyncio semaphore limiting concurrent Edge TTS requests (max 3).

nodes.name: edge_tts
nodes.summary: Synthesize speech via Microsoft Edge TTS: semaphore-limited, rate-limited, retry with exponential backoff + jitter for 401/NoAudioReceived, collects word boundaries for subtitle alignment (edge_word_boundaries_to_cues + save_alignment), optionally saves audio to output_path, returns MP3 bytes.

nodes.name: get_audio_duration
nodes.summary: Get audio duration in seconds via ffmpeg probe, falling back to a file-size estimate (~2KB/s MP3) with a 1s floor.

nodes.name: list_voices
nodes.summary: List Edge TTS voice ShortNames, optionally locale-filtered, with the same semaphore + retry strategy.
